column1: # Common English misspellings and their fixes, one "misspelling<TAB>fix" per line, sorted. A third
# column, where there is one, is the fix for English outside the US and the Philippines (jewelery
# to jewellery on en_GB and en_AU, jewelry on en_US). Canada takes the third column too, except
# where Canadian spelling keeps the US form: -ize words (realize) and fulfill.
# Hand-made list. No misspelling here is accepted by the en_US, en_GB, en_AU, en_CA or en_ZA
# Hunspell dictionaries or listed by SCOWL up to size 70. A few start a longer word ("usefull",
# "usefully"), but apart from names like Tehran, no word ranked 150 or higher starts with one.
# as --misspellings and leave these words out of data.json, en_supplemental.json and
# dictionaries/en.txt. The Latin provider corrects them for English unless the user taught one.
